title_en: Arctic OCS exploratory drilling – reopening of comment period
title_ja: 米内務省、北極圏外縁大陸棚の試掘規則案の意見募集を再開

This document is scheduled to be published in the

DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR

Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement

30 CFR Parts 250 and 254

Bureau of Ocean Energy Management

30 CFR Part 550

[Docket ID: BSEE--2026-0133 EEAA021000 – 278E1700D2 – ET1SF0000.EAQ000]

RIN 1082-AA05

Oil and Gas and Sulfur Operations in the Outer Continental Shelf—Revisions to the

Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on the Arctic Outer Continental Shelf; Reopening

of Comment Period

AGENCIES: Marine Minerals Administration (MMA), Bureau of Safety and Environmental

Enforcement (BSEE), Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), Interior.

ACTION: Proposed rule; reopening of public comment period.

SUMMARY: The Department of the Interior (DOI or Department), acting through MMA, is

reopening the comment period for Proposed Rule: Oil and Gas and Sulfur Operations in the

Outer Continental Shelf—Revisions to the Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on the Arctic

Outer Continental Shelf, which was published in the Federal Register on August 6, 2026.

DATES: The comment period for the proposed rule published August 6, 2026, at 91 FR 50998,

is reopened. Comments should be received on or before [INSERT DATE 30 DAYS AFTER

DATE OF PUBLICATION IN THE FEDERAL REGISTER].

ADDRESSES: You may submit comments on the rulemaking by any of the following methods.

For comments on this proposed rule and associated documents, please use the Regulation

Identifier Number (RIN) 1082-AA05 as an identifier in your message.

      Federal eRulemaking Portal: https://www.regulations.gov. In the entry entitled, “Enter

Keyword or ID,” enter BSEE-2026-0133, then click search. Follow the instructions to submit

[Page 2]
public comments and view supporting and related materials available for this rulemaking,

including a plain language summary of the proposed rule as required by 5 U.S.C. 553(b)(4). The

Bureaus may post all submitted comments. You may continue to submit information collection-

related comments to the Federal eRulemaking Portal even though the opportunity to submit

Paperwork Reduction Act-related comments on this proposed rule through the Office of

Management and Budget’s online portal is no longer available. However, please reference

“OMB Control Number 1014-0036 (Revisions to the Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on

the Arctic Outer Continental Shelf)” for Part 250 related comments or “OMB Control Number

1010-0151 (Revisions to the Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on the Arctic Outer

Continental Shelf)” for Part 550 related comments, as applicable, in the subject line of your

comments.

      Mail or hand-carry comments to the DOI, MMA: Attention: Regulations and Standards

Branch, 45600 Woodland Road, VAE-ORP, Sterling VA 20166. Please reference RIN 1082-

AA05, “Oil and Gas and Sulfur Operations on the Outer Continental Shelf—Revisions to the

Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on the Arctic Outer Continental Shelf,” in your

comments, and include your name and return address.

      Email: [Email omitted.].

      Public Availability of Comments: Please be aware that MMA’s practice is to make

comments, including the names and addresses of individuals, available for public inspection.

Before including your address, phone number, email address, and any personally identifiable

information in your comment, please be advised that your entire comment, including your

personally identifiable information, may be made publicly available at any time. For the Agency

to consider withholding from disclosure your personally identifiable information, you must

identify, in a cover letter, any information contained in your comments that, if released, would

constitute a clearly unwarranted invasion of your personal privacy. You must also briefly

[Page 3]
describe any possible harmful consequences of the disclosure of information, such as

embarrassment, injury, or other harm.

[Contact block omitted.]
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: On August 6, 2026, the Department published the

Proposed Rule: Oil and Gas and Sulfur Operations in the Outer Continental Shelf—Revisions to

the Requirements for Exploratory Drilling on the Arctic Outer Continental Shelf (91 FR 50998)

and opened a 60-day public comment period, which closed on October 5, 2026. After

publication of the proposed rule, MMA received requests to extend the comment period on the

proposed rule. MMA is reopening the original comment period by an additional 30 days to

provide additional time for review of and comment on the Notice of Proposed Rulemaking.

Accordingly, comments must be submitted by the extended due date of [INSERT DATE 30

DAYS AFTER DATE OF PUBLICATION IN THE FEDERAL REGISTER]. MMA may not

fully consider comments received after this date. Secretary's Order 3451 established the Marine

Minerals Administration (MMA), which replaced BOEM and BSEE, and provided for a

transition period during which existing MMA officials retain operational authority necessary for

the uninterrupted accomplishment of its mission. That transition period is ongoing. Accordingly,

this notice references BOEM, BSEE and MMA but is issued under the authority of the MMA.
[Signer name omitted.]
Director, Office of Surface Mining, Reclamation, and Enforcement,
Exercising Authority of the Assistant Secretary - Land and Minerals Management.
[FR Doc. 2026-23145 Filed: 11/12/2026 8:45 am; Publication Date: 11/13/2026]
translation_ja:
## 1ページ（対象箇所）

米内務省の海洋鉱物局（MMA）、安全環境執行局（BSEE）、海洋エネルギー管理局（BOEM）。北極圏の外縁大陸棚における石油・ガス・硫黄事業の試掘要件を見直す規則案。2026年8月6日付91 FR 50998で公表した規則案への意見募集を再開する。提出期限は官報掲載から30日後と記載。規則番号はRIN 1082-AA05、案件BSEE-2026-0133。

## 2ページ（対象箇所）

連邦の規則策定ポータルには提出手順、関連資料と平易な規則案の要約がある。行政管理予算局のオンライン窓口は情報収集に関する当該募集を終了しているが、連邦ポータルで引き続き意見を出せる。30 CFR Part 250に関する番号は1014-0036、Part 550は1010-0151。郵送・持参も可能。提出した個人情報を含め意見全体が公開され得る旨の注意がある。

## 3ページ（対象箇所）

8月6日に開始した60日間の募集は10月5日に終了した。延長要請を受け、追加の検討・意見提出のため30日間再開する。期限後の意見は十分に考慮されない場合がある。内務長官命令3451によりMMAがBOEMとBSEEを引き継ぐ。移行期間中の権限に基づき、MMAがこの通知を発出した。
facts_ja: 北極圏外縁大陸棚の試掘要件の規則案について、官報掲載から30日間の意見募集再開を告知。最終規則、採掘許可、増産量は未確認。
inference_ja: 規則の最終文言と許可・掘削実績が将来の投資・供給を左右する。
missing_parts: 翻訳したページにも未訳の脚注・定型欄または一部段落がある。担当者氏名と連絡先は収録対象外。PDFバイナリは未保存。
